name: Andrea Valderrama

bio.statement: Valderrama's official biography says that when appointed in 2021 she became the first Peruvian American in the Oregon Legislature.
bio.excerpt: When I was appointed in 2021, I became the first Peruvian American in the Oregon State Legislature.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Rep. Valderrama member page

bio.statement: Her official biography cites a background in grassroots organizing, coalition building, and policy and budget advocacy.
bio.excerpt: extensive background in grassroots organizing, coalition building, and policy and budget advocacy

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Rep. Valderrama member page

bio.statement: Her pamphlet statement lists Valderrama's occupation as State Representative and nonprofit director, with a background in policy advising and advocacy, coalition building and community organizing in the public and non-profit sectors.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: State Representative; Nonprofit director Occupational Background: Policy advising and advocacy, coalition building, community organizing in public and non-profit sectors

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 54

bio.statement: Her pamphlet statement lists a Masters of Public Administration from Portland State University and a Bachelor of Arts from the University of Oregon.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: Masters of Public Administration, Portland State University; Bachelor of Arts, University of Oregon

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 54

bio.statement: Her pamphlet statement lists chair of the David Douglas School Board as prior governmental experience.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: David Douglas School Board, Chair

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: Valderrama says in her pamphlet statement that she fights for lower healthcare and food costs and for protecting the health care families rely on.
positions.excerpt: I fight for practical results for outer East Portland: lowering healthcare and food costs, improving safety, and protecting the health care families rely on.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: Valderrama says in her pamphlet statement that she delivered stronger protections for renters and homeowners and investment in housing and eviction prevention.
positions.excerpt: I’ve delivered stronger protections for renters and homeowners, invested in housing and eviction prevention, protected Medicaid and SNAP

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: For community safety, Valderrama's pamphlet statement cites investments in behavioral health and addiction treatment and youth violence prevention.
positions.excerpt: I supported investments in behavioral health and addiction treatment, youth violence prevention, and safe streets and reliable transit on Glisan and 122nd

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: Valderrama's pamphlet statement cites safe streets and reliable transit on Glisan and 122nd.
positions.excerpt: safe streets and reliable transit on Glisan and 122nd because families should not have to risk their lives crossing the street.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: Valderrama says in her pamphlet statement that she protected Medicaid and SNAP and expanded maternal health investments.
positions.excerpt: protected Medicaid and SNAP, expanded maternal health investments, and helped remove medical debt from credit reports.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: Valderrama says in her pamphlet statement that she worked to stop wage theft and strengthen protections for farmworkers and other low-wage workers.
positions.excerpt: I’ve also worked to stop wage theft and strengthen protections for farmworkers and other low-wage workers.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: Valderrama says in her pamphlet statement that she will keep standing up for immigrant and refugee communities when federal policies threaten programs Oregonians rely on.
positions.excerpt: I will continue standing up for low-income families, seniors, children, and immigrant and refugee communities when federal policies threaten the programs working Oregonians rely on.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: Valderrama says in her pamphlet statement that she will keep fighting for strong public schools, saying schools need stronger investment.
positions.excerpt: schools that need stronger investment so our children can succeed.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 54
